name: Troels Holger Vaaben
tagline: Microbes, metabolism and human health. Troels Holger Vaaben, scientist and Co-PI at DTU BRIGHT.

paragraphs: I’m Troels, a scientist and Co-PI at DTU BRIGHT. I work on microbial foods, microbiome research and metabolic health, with a background in experimental cancer research and synthetic biology.

I started at the bench, engineering bacteria and working with experimental models. These days I spend much of my time connecting multi-omics data to biological questions, supervising researchers, and building tools that make the work easier to reproduce.

AI has become part of that work: research agents, protein and DNA foundation models, and practical training for colleagues. I’m interested in where these tools help us ask better questions—and how we check their answers.
